isospin_rule.statement: every continuum family carries the smallest isospin compatible with its charge, I = |I3| with 2 I3 = 2Q - B - S; the continuum and direct vertices weight each channel by the Clebsch-Gordan share |<I_b I3_b; I_c I3_c | I I3>|^2 (both orderings summed for two members of one multiplet), the Round 2 kernel's convention
isospin_rule.physics: systems excited by an isospin-zero (colorless, neutral) exchange keep the isospin of the excited hadron: I = 1/2 for an excited nucleon (p pi0 : n pi+ = 1 : 2), I = 0 for a central mesonic system (pi+ pi- : pi0 pi0 = 2 : 1; omega pi0, eta pi0, f2 pi0 and rho0 omega forbidden)
isospin_rule.evidence: census at the sealed R51f optimum (2026-09-30): with unit couplings the neutral pions are 43% of all pions against one third, and the NA49 neutron dN/dx_F is exceeded by 30 to 55% at x_F 0.3 to 0.6 (_knowledge/evidence/topology-multiplicity-deficit-2026-09-28.md)
